next.reason: 1985: 'PAGE LIMIT IS integer-1 LINE [HEADING integer-2] [FIRST DETAIL integer-3] [LAST DETAIL integer-4] [FOOTING integer-5]'; 2023: 'Either integer-1 or integer-2 or both shall be specified. ... phrases may be written in any order.'. 2023 accepts every 1985 form but adds cases: integer-1 optional with a COLUMNS width, LAST CONTROL HEADING, DE/CH abbreviations and free phrase order.
